description: This Java class 'EdgeEventSourcingListener' handles various edge-related entity events in the Thingsboard platform, such as save, delete, relation, and action events, and forwards notifications to edge nodes via cluster service. It manages edge synchronization and filters specific entity types and actions.

classes.name: EdgeEventSourcingListener
classes.description: Handles entity events related to edges, such as save, delete, relation, and action events, and forwards notifications to edge nodes, managing edge synchronization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the listener, logs initiation message.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Overloaded method to handle SaveEntityEvent, DeleteEntityEvent, ActionEntityEvent, and RelationActionEvent, processing and forwarding edge notifications accordingly.

methods.name: getEdgeEventActionTypeForEntityEvent
methods.description: Determines the EdgeEventActionType based on the entity instance.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles SaveEntityEvent, filters out non-relevant entities, constructs message body, and sends notification.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles DeleteEntityEvent, filters out system tenants and edges, constructs message, and sends notification.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles ActionEntityEvent, filters specific actions/entities, constructs message, and sends notification.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles RelationActionEvent, filters tenant existence and relation type, constructs message, and sends notification.

methods.name: isValidSaveEntityEventForEdgeProcessing
methods.description: Validates whether a SaveEntityEvent should be processed for edge synchronization based on entity type and state.

methods.name: cleanUpUserAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Cleans up additional info in User object before processing.

methods.name: getEdgeEventTypeForEntityEvent
methods.description: Returns EdgeEventType based on entity type, e.g., AlarmComment.

methods.name: getBodyMsgForEntityEvent
methods.description: Generates message body string for specific entity types.

methods.name: getActionForEntityEvent
methods.description: Determines the EdgeEventActionType based on entity and creation status.
